title: Mole-style compact output
notes: for manual runs; homebrew, yarn, mole and msupdate failures from the
result: manual terminal runs show a preflight line, a spinner per plugin and one status block per plugin, with the full output in `~/Library/Logs/RocketUpdater/run-<RUN_ID>.log`; `--verbose` keeps the streamed output. Kept in bash rather than Node: the run itself upgrades the node formula, and launchd runs need no extra runtime. Homebrew's pillow/pydantic failure was pip-installed pillow 12.2.0 and typing_extensions in Homebrew's Python site-packages; the pip copies were removed and both kegs linked. Disabled casks are reported, unlinked kegs named, yarn's empty version fails with yarn's reason, mole's version parses, msupdate's XPC failure is a skip.
evidence: `tests/runner/compact-ui.sh`, `tests/plugins/yarn-version.sh`, `tests/plugins/homebrew.sh`, `tests/plugins/mole.sh`; full suite and shellcheck green; real compact run 25 ok, 0 failed, 2 skipped in 5m46s.
